name: corner_palazzo
notes: An L-shaped Venetian palazzo with two arms each 16 m long and 8 m deep, three storeys of ochre-washed stucco with pointed-arch windows under a low terracotta hip roof. The outer faces of the L are its fronts, one along local -Z and one along -X; the inner corner is a paved courtyard with a well head, and the anchor is the outer corner.
